{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data and ensure we're using the latest version
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Identify the most recent sample for each patient
# Since sample_seq is the assay run number, keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_dedup = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {trial_df_dedup.shape[0]}')

# Check for duplicates again
print(f'Number of duplicate patient IDs after deduplication: {trial_df_dedup.duplicated(subset=["patient_id"], keep=False).sum()}')

# Now inspect the data for analysis
print('\nSummary of deduplicated data:')
print(trial_df_dedup[['arm', 'severity', 'sex', 'age']].describe(include='all'))

# Check the distribution of arms and severity
print('\nDistribution of arms:')
print(trial_df_dedup['arm'].value_counts())

print('\nDistribution of severity:')
print(trial_df_dedup['severity'].value_counts())

# Check for imbalance between arms and severity
print('\nCross-tabulation of arm and severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df_dedup['arm'], trial_df_dedup['severity']))"}
